scenarios.request: Upgrade this service from Java 8 to Java 21.
scenarios.rationale: A same-stack runtime upgrade routes to the library, which then opens its version-uplift reference.

scenarios.request: Plan the framework upgrade from Spring Boot 2 to 3.
scenarios.rationale: A framework upgrade is a version uplift, so the framework upgrade intent must route to the library.

scenarios.request: Do a version uplift of the billing module.
scenarios.rationale: The reference's own name must route to the skill that owns it.
A Python major bump is one of the reference examples, so it must route to the library.
The common .NET phrasing must route to the library without the word dotnet.

scenarios.request: Upgrade Node.js 16 to 20 across the services.
scenarios.rationale: A Node.js major bump is one of the reference examples, so it must route to the library.

scenarios.request: Upgrade the requests package to the latest release.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a single package upgrade is not a runtime or framework uplift.

scenarios.request: Bump the plugin version in the changelog.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a release version edit that says bump must not route to the library.

scenarios.request: Upgrade dependencies to the latest versions.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a dependency refresh that says upgrade and versions is not a runtime uplift.

scenarios.request: Bump major version of the lodash package.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a major bump of one package is not a runtime or framework uplift.

scenarios.request: Upgrade the runtime memory limit on the container.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a resource limit change that says upgrade and runtime must not route to the library.

scenarios.request: Write the release notes for the version upgrade.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: writing about an upgrade is documentation work, not an uplift.

scenarios.request: Upgrade the node pool in the cluster.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a cluster node upgrade is infrastructure work, not a Node.js uplift.
Negative control: refreshing an old pull request belongs to modernize, not to the version-uplift reference.
